title: Difference
description: data of: difference.py NEW --reference REF --json. What is brighter in NEW than in REF, by proper image subtraction (ZOGY), with each candidate's score in units of the noise at its place. Candidates are not vetted: hot pixels, asteroids, variable stars and known transients are not yet ruled out. Also kept as candidates.json beside the new stack.

score.description: How many times the local noise.

as_strong_fading.description: How many peaks on the fading side score at least this much: what noise and imperfect subtraction alone produce. Near 0 for a real new star.

mag.description: Brightness of what is new, unfiltered, calibrated approximately to Gaia G; only when the new stack has a depth.json.

flux_ratio.description: New stack's brightness over the reference's, from the stars they share.

usable_share.description: Share of the reference's pixels where candidates are trusted: covered by both, away from edges and bright stars.

dipoles_left_out.description: Peaks with a dark partner beside them: misplaced stars, not new ones.

planted.description: With --plant: fake transients added to the new stack, and how many were found.
